population_total_basis: Printed national all-persons total by religious affiliation per wave: 2002 Table 23 (10,065); 2011 Table 23 / Table 25 (9,945); 2021 Table 25 / G-7 (11,680). The universe is all persons in every wave (the probe verified the 2002 religion column is all-persons, not the Nauruan-only tribe universe). The 2021 Nauruan citizen/dual district table (Table 19, total 11,215) is a separate sub-universe, not this series.
